assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic 3D game hangar LEFT SIDE WALL elevation texture, wide 5:2 aspect ratio. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY, not a composition to copy. Build a perfectly straight-on orthographic wall elevation of the SAME carrier maintenance hangar: weathered ivory enamel modules, dark gunmetal structural ribs, dense real engineering, grey steel, warm amber practical lamps, restrained cyan diagnostic lights, ochre safety handrails. Three large EMPTY mobile-suit servicing recesses arranged horizontally at equal intervals, all within the same wall plane. No robots, no humans, no character images, no hologram screens. Two horizontal service galleries at one quarter and just over half the wall height, many compact pipes, cable trays, hydraulic housings and panel fasteners. Empty dark service recesses remain visibly detailed, no solid black voids. The image fills exactly the entire wall from base at bottom to roof beam at top. NO room perspective, NO receding vanishing point, NO foreground floor, NO view of opposite or adjoining walls, no ceiling plane. All vertical supports parallel to image edges, horizontal galleries completely horizontal. Cinematic realistic material detail matching reference, balanced cool indirect illumination with small warm worklights; photographic rather than cartoon, clean readable industrial architecture, subtle dirt and edge wear. No typography or watermark. This is the port servicing side, with slim coolant manifolds and control cupboards between bays.
